reasoning.step1:
Document classification:
- Contains clear invoice indicators: "Rechnung"/"Invoice", "Invoice Date", "Total Amount/Gesamtbetrag", line items, subtotals, VAT line → classify as invoice.
- No exclusion indicators ("Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung", "Servicebericht") present.

Locate candidate fields and alternatives:
- Invoice Date: "Fakturadatum 15.05.2023" and "Invoice Date" label → Invoice.Date = "15.05.2023".
- VAT ID of sender: two VATs shown:
  - "Ihre USt.-ID-Nr. ATU22642807" (Your VAT No. — belongs to customer/Bill-To),
  - "Unsere USt.-ID-Nr. ATU16040004" (Our VAT No. — sender) → Sender.VatId = "ATU16040004".
- Grand total: "Gesamtbetrag ... 1.716,00" / "Total Amount" → GrandTotal.Amount = 1716.00.
- Net amount: "Zwischensumme o. USt. ... 1.560,00" / "Subtotal before output tax" → Net.Amount = 1560.00.
- VAT rate and VAT amount: "Umsatzsteuer 10,00 % von 1.560,00 EUR" and amount shown "156,00" → Vat.Rate = 10, Vat.Amount = 156.00.

Verify no inference or ambiguity:
- All values appear explicitly; no need to guess.
- Decimal formatting kept (two decimals) and VAT rate returned without percent sign per rules.
- All required schema fields are present.
